1272.note_text: In this Recommendation, this term refers to the determination of an element in a reference solution free of interferents. The baseline noise is established by measuring the output signal of several aliquots of a blank test solution.

1270.note_text: the concentration of an element that provides a signal equivalent to three times the standard deviation of the baseline noise as determined on a statistical basis. It is the minimum quantity measured before it can be concluded that an element has been detected
